subject: Render DELTA8 READY: backboardd inert, 128/32 traces, path preserve, path_blit inert
body:
Render DELTA8 complete host-only; no native/phone/publish/commit.

1. Runtime inert: render_pipeline.inc includes compute newly added compositor_process.h and calls tegu_compositor_process_is_backboardd(). With TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES compiled in, only backboardd gets nonnil inert PSOs; non-backboardd and flag-off still return nil/NSError. Host sets compute existing tegu_host_process_backboardd for both scopes.
2. Traces: first128 per process TEGU_INERT_PIPELINE v=<fn> f=<fn> fmt=<comma descriptor formats> reason=<admission>; first32 TEGU_INERT_DRAW_REFUSED. Host creates 130 inert PSOs and asserts exactly128 pipeline lines; 40 inert draws assert exactly32 draw lines.
3. path preserve: full MULTI_TARGET plan written mask is authoritative for path_* only. Written single -> per-RT at that target; contiguous multi -> v4 target count capped; holes -> per-RT. Unwritten active targets get preserve mask; their pass clear jobs are removed and endEncoding does not recreate them. Host path_cubic all-four masks active, shader writes RT2 only: active=4 main=2 preserve=0xb, command count2 (RT2 clear+draw), status4. Non-path strict mismatch unchanged.
4. path_blit true-MRT+attachment2 fetch has no exact snapshot transport, so it is explicitly inert in backboardd with reason true-MRT framebuffer fetch unsupported; non-backboardd/flag-off nil/error and no inert trace. No direct target sampling or false draw.

Host rc0 both ASan/UBSan fake-JM binaries; prior TLS16, authored v4, path_cubic, pass/v3/v2/ASTC tests green. ARM64 JM -Werror syntax PASS default+inert. Diffcheck clean.
